'''Operation Molten Splinter''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and the Imperial Navy [[Battle of the Taspan system|defended]] Republic defector [[Boro Fareed]] in the [[Taspan system]], and [[Battle of the Ezran system|wiped out]] the [[Ezran pirates]].
